objective.name: sandbox.dsl.query.read.write.read.branch
objective.description: Use local query/read meaning to write a matter, read it back, and branch on the committed value.

#root.role: Rebuild the local projection, select one local element through meaning.query, read its detailed meaning, write one matter from that descriptor, read the matter back, and branch on the committed field.

effects.local_projection_refresh: The local projection is refreshed before the query.
effects.local_meaning_selection: One local projected element is selected and read in detail.
effects.meaning_driven_matter_write: The selected descriptor materializes one local matter revision.
effects.committed_branch: The branch decision is taken from the committed matter value.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one branch-specific terminal response after a local reflective selection is materialized into a matter and then re-read.
invariants: The branch decision is taken from the committed local matter field produced after write and readback, not from the pre-commit meaning alias.
The local projection is rebuilt before the query so the selected projected row comes from a refreshed local index.
success: When the committed message equals sandbox.echo, the terminal payload exposes summary and ctx_id from sandbox.consume.record.
The local matter revision stores the selected descriptor name and description before the final branch executes.
failure: The flow fails if rebuild, query, read.meaning, matter.write, or matter.read fails before the branch.
The flow can still terminate through the else branch if the committed message does not match the expected selected capacity name.
notes: This scenario validates a longer reflective chain query -> read -> write -> read -> branch inside a single DSL flow.
The else branch keeps the contract exhaustive, but the fixture data is arranged so the consume.record path is normally taken.

filters.value: Wrapper-backed echo capacity for N5 inter-instance tests
